2027_blinding_contract.first_2027_score: after historical methodology and source contract are frozen

V0_signal_existence_contract.null: Independently permute class labels within each fixed V10 cell, preserving every cell's marginal distribution while destroying cross-cell class coherence.
V0_signal_existence_contract.reliability_estimator: max(0, 1 - mean(null class-score variance) / observed class-score variance). This Phase 0A estimator is diagnostic until an expanded player-level target panel is available.
V0_signal_existence_contract.statistic: sample variance of overall class log-strength score

application_contract.slot_bucket_loading_if_later_estimated: Monotone non-increasing by later pick range and heavily shrunk; collapse to one scalar if data cannot distinguish loadings.

forbidden: fit class strength to KTC or other market prices
use eventual declaration or NFL draft status to define the anchor cohort
use actual NFL Draft capital not known at the historical anchor
use current rankings to reconstruct historical rankings
manually reconstruct old rankings from memory
use end-of-season anchor-year stats as if known by October 15
fit multiple raw class-level predictors on a tiny class sample
tune after seeing a 2027 class score

future_validation_gates_to_preregister_b.M1_oos_skill_vs_M0: Must be positive and materially better than neutral under walk-forward and LOCO; exact threshold frozen before fitting.
future_validation_gates_to_preregister_b.calibration: Out-of-sample calibration slope must remain positive and stable.
future_validation_gates_to_preregister_b.covid_sensitivity: Report results with and without affected anchor/classes.
future_validation_gates_to_preregister_b.influence: No single class may dominate apparent model skill.
future_validation_gates_to_preregister_b.naive_benchmark: Sophisticated M1 must justify complexity versus a fixed simple index.

historical_target_contract.class_score: For each class and R1-R4 early/mid/late cell, compute log(class cell H3.O2 EV / leave-one-class-out baseline cell EV). Overall score is the equal-cell mean of the 12 log ratios. Multiplier = exp(overall score).
historical_target_contract.current_panel_role: Phase 0A target/reliability diagnostic only. Six classes are insufficient to authorize predictor-model fitting.
historical_target_contract.future_expansion_requirement: Expand to older complete classes using the same market-free outcome definition before predictor modeling.
historical_target_contract.initial_lineage: Draft Pick FV V10 H3.O2 fundamental outcome panel
historical_target_contract.vorp_alternative: A new VORP-style target may be studied only as a robustness alternative after auditing whether expanded V10-lineage H3.O2 can be reproduced consistently. It is not silently substituted.

lead_time_contract.college_production_primary: Prior completed season, age/position normalized; partial anchor-year season is robustness-only because schedules and 2020 availability are not comparable.
lead_time_contract.longer_horizon_policy: A one-year-lead model cannot be applied to classes 2+ years out. Those remain 1.00 unless a separately validated longer-horizon model is built.
lead_time_contract.primary_anchor: September 15 through October 15 of year before NFL Draft

objective: Estimate whether an upcoming rookie class has greater or lower market-free fundamental expected player value than a neutral historical class, using only information genuinely available at the same forecast lead time.

prospect_cohort_contract.anchor_recall_definition: Share of eventual high-value/top rookie-draft outcomes represented in the anchor-date eligible candidate universe; diagnostic caps predictability and quantifies unseen risers.
prospect_cohort_contract.required_definition: Prospective eligibility cohort determined only from information known by the anchor date, such as recruiting-class/year-since-HS eligibility rules.

scientific_architecture.M1: One continuous overall class-strength factor; default candidate.
scientific_architecture.M2: Apex-plus-depth extension is conditional only and cannot be attempted until distinct target reliability and out-of-sample improvement gates are pre-specified and passed.
scientific_architecture.V0: Before examining predictors, test whether the realized historical class-strength target contains coherent class-level signal beyond cell-specific sampling noise.
scientific_architecture.stage1: If V0 and source gates permit, fit a low-capacity PLAYER-LEVEL expected-fundamental-outcome model using anchor-date features with draft class as the cross-validation cluster.
scientific_architecture.stage2: Aggregate strictly out-of-fold player predictions into one class-level signal.
scientific_architecture.stage3: Use only a minimal heavily-shrunk class-level calibration; do not regress many raw features on approximately ten classes.
